picks.annotation: Buy when you want your turrets to last very long duration especially useful for base defense or midboss setup. More efficient to just have Duration Extender, but if you want to upgrade buy this.

picks.name: Spirit Resilience
picks.annotation: We usually don't need this item unless the enemy team has 5 or more spirit Heroes.

picks.name: Escalating Exposure
picks.annotation: Escalating is better than Boundless after exactly 4.23s of gaining stacks (6 stacks) without any time lag inbetween. Boundless for this test had Mystic Vuln while Escalating had Improved Spirit.

picks.name: Intensifying Magazine
picks.annotation: Buy if you think that you can get away with gun in the lane. Your goal when you buy this is you will shoot the enemy a lot with your gun + take guardian faster after 5 min.

picks.name: Spirit Burn
picks.annotation: Buy when you need severe anti-heal and they have no sign of debuff remover. You can't reliaby target whoever you want with spirit burn unless you ult.

picks.name: Heroic Aura
picks.annotation: Fire rate for turrets. Indespensible for turrets during MIDBOSS or BASE DEFENSE. Remember to spread turrets the AoE for Heroic is decently big.

picks.name: Greater Expansion
picks.annotation: Buy when you want ULT SPLASH AOE BIGGER (THEY CANT JUMP) + turrets to have very high ability range to attack from very far distances. Also applies to heal and ult AoE.

picks.name: Enchanter's Emblem
picks.annotation: S tier item this patch because spirit damage is META. This provides offensive and defensive bonuses the best of both worlds + CDR.

picks.name: Suppressor
picks.annotation: Sometimes you want less firerate via turret but I wouldn't recommend this for ult-maxxing most of the time b/c slots are already limited. If you decide to do more gun or turret consider it.

picks.name: Mystic Slow
picks.annotation: Slows down enemies hit by wall and turrets even more allowing your ally or your ultimate to deal more consistent damage. Builds into Lightning scroll later.
